import/no-default-export.reason: Convex needs the default export of convex.config.ts, schema.ts, http.ts and crons.ts.

import/no-named-export.reason: Convex names each registered function after its named export.

no-undefined.reason: Convex removes a field from a document only when patch passes it undefined.

unicorn/no-null.reason: Convex has no undefined value, so the schema and the returns validators hold null.
